name: Bridget Trostle
source:
She is a well known streamer referred to as Bridgybear by her fans. Known pretty well for playing video games and being really good at them. She honestly believes that what makes her so good at gaming is that she secretly has powers that aid her in excelling. 

Outside of gaming, she’s a bubbly girl who enjoys talking about what she has in common with others, along with finding it funny to tease or joke around with people often.
